Souls have created a soul society with traditional values in mind. Even though people are modern, there is no technology, people live simply. The reason is that there is no fuel or electricity. They believe that dead souls are reincarnated or judged again, and then sent to the right heaven or hell. But bad souls don't go to the soul society. Evil souls go to other dimensions or stay on earth where they hunt lost souls or even people. These souls are called "Hollows".
